invariants.name: visibility_does_not_extract_full_tree
invariants.note: Issue #8 §3.2 visibility mutation must not default to a full-tree extract. Nana LayoutStyle.hidden dirties the ancestor chain (live dump layout_nodes=12, render_nodes_changed=12); do not claim layout_nodes==0. Evaluate when work_counters.render_nodes_changed is present.

invariants.name: visibility_does_not_layout_full_tree
invariants.note: Visibility schedules layout along the ancestor chain, not the full 5k tree. The honest bound is layout_nodes <= 64 (live dump 12), never layout_nodes==0.
